scope: Current PR #43 visual review only; documentation of authorized bounded adoption; activation and final qualification pending
auditMethod: Retained Node24/npm11.19 package-lock-only, ignore-scripts audit with separate empty npmrc files. Exact-version semver reconciliation and primary advisory/source review. No new registry scan, install, lifecycle, action, exploit or upstream rebuild was performed for the ADR.

sourceReview.limitations: Non-development lock membership does not prove bundled presence. Shared source overlap does not identify a distinct bundled version; no source hit does not prove absence. No complete source-to-bundle rebuild.
